# decisions/ — Architecture Decision Records

Append-only. One short ADR per **irreversible or surprising** decision, with the
reasoning and the date. An ADR is not documentation of how something works — that
belongs in `DESIGN.md` (intent) or in the code (mechanism). An ADR exists to stop a
future session from re-deriving, re-litigating, or silently reversing a choice.

**Do not edit an accepted ADR to change its decision.** Write a new one that
supersedes it, and add a `Superseded by ADR NNNN` line to the old one. ADRs 0019
through 0022 are corrections of earlier framings and are the pattern to follow.

Every ADR carries a **What this forbids** section. That section is the operative
part for a coding session — it is what turns intent into something checkable in
review.

## Template

```markdown
# ADR NNNN — Title in the imperative or as a claim

*Status: accepted · YYYY-MM-DD · where the decision came from*

## Decision
What was decided, stated flatly.

## Why
The reasoning, including what the alternative was and why it lost.

## What this forbids
- The concrete things a future session must not do.
```
